name: Manifold
description: One CV in, three shaped outs with comparator modes

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — input trim on channel 0; attenuverter (CV) or threshold (Gate/Trigger) on channels 1–3
Alt (Shift) — input offset on channel 0; output offset (CV) or hysteresis (Gate/Trigger) on channels 1–3
Third (Btn hold) — input slew on channel 0; output slew (CV), minimum gate length (Gate) or pulse length (Trigger) on channels 1–3
Channel 0 while the internal LFO runs — the three layers become morph, LFO speed and skew instead of trim, offset and slew

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Channel 0 short — freeze the conditioned input value
Channel 0 Shift + short — while the internal LFO runs: free-running or clock-synced (the button flashes when sync engages)
Channels 1–3 short — mute/unmute that output (Shift not held); fader scrub while the button is held cancels the tap
Channels 1–3 Shift + long — cycle that out through CV → Gate → Trigger; the new mode hue appears immediately and the configurator follows

sections.heading: Signal / LEDs
items: One CV input on channel 0, three outputs B/C/D on channels 1–3
Five equidistant hues from blue through violet and red to orange, one per operating mode: channel 0 on CV in, channel 0 on the internal LFO, then CV, Gate and Trigger on the outs
Channel 0 is blue while CV in is active and one step warmer when the internal LFO runs; each out takes the hue of its current mode, so a mode swap shows up immediately
With nothing patched into the input, channel 0 becomes an internal morphing LFO that feeds B/C/D — Source forces CV In or Internal LFO instead of that auto fallback
LFO Speed shifts the whole speed range to Slow or Slowest
CV mode uses the configured Range; Gate and Trigger modes drive the jack as a digital GPO and ignore Range
Defaults: B = CV, C = Gate, D = Trigger (±5 V on the CV path)
Channel 0 LEDs dim with the active source amplitude in the source hue
CV outs dim with the shaped output level; Gate/Trigger meter the conditioned input while low and flash full when high
Button LEDs use the same mode hues and breathe with their signal level: channel 0 stays bright when frozen; channels 1–3 turn off when muted

channels.jackDescription: CV input. Set In Range to 0–10 V for unipolar sources or ±5 V for bipolar sources. With nothing patched, the internal LFO takes over as the source.
channels.faderDescription: CV: attenuverter on the input signal — centre is zero, left inverts, right passes through. Internal LFO: morphs the wave from ramp through triangle, sine and square into chaos.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: CV: shifts the conditioned input up or down before the per-output stages. Internal LFO: rate, or the clock division when sync is on.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: CV: smooths changes on the conditioned input. Internal LFO: skews the wave towards rising or falling.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap holds the conditioned input value; all outputs stop moving.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: While the internal LFO runs, toggles between free-running and clock-synced. The button flashes when sync engages; a stopped transport parks the wave.
channels.ledTop: Input amplitude in the source hue (blue for CV in, one step warmer while the internal LFO runs)
channels.ledBottom: Input amplitude in the source hue (blue for CV in, one step warmer while the internal LFO runs)

channels.jackDescription: Output B. Mode sets CV, Gate or Trigger; Range only applies in CV mode.
channels.faderDescription: CV: attenuverter on the conditioned input. Gate/Trigger: comparator threshold.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: CV: output offset. Gate/Trigger: hysteresis below the threshold.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: CV: output slew. Gate: minimum gate length. Trigger: pulse length.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap without Shift mutes the output. Scrubbing the fader while the button is held prevents the tap, and Shift is reserved for the mode swap.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift + long press cycles this out through CV → Gate → Trigger. The mode is stored as a parameter, so the configurator follows.
channels.ledTop: Mode hue × amplitude (CV out / Gate–Trigger input or flash)
channels.ledBottom: Mode hue × amplitude (CV out / Gate–Trigger input or flash)
